flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: The Democrats' chances of winning Senate control rose sharply in the Polymarket odds, with the party still favoured. In [[Mississippi]], the Democrat Scott Colom gained a lot of ground against the Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith, and the market sees it as a predicted flip. The Republican Pete Ricketts also made a sharp gain in [[Nebraska]]. The projected seat count recently changed to 50-50, which would leave the chamber split evenly, compared with 53-47 before.
summaries.governor: Polymarket odds moved sharply in four governor's races over the past day. The Democrat in [[Nevada]], Aaron Ford, gained ground in what the market treats as a predicted flip, and the Democrat in [[Kansas]], Cindy Holscher, also saw a sharp rise in their chances. The Republican in Vermont, Phil Scott, and the Democrat in Oregon, Tina Kotek, each strengthened as well.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds for Democrats to win control of the House rose by a sizable amount, and the market continues to favour them. Two Democratic candidates gained sharply: Lakesha Womack in [[NC-14 (Gastonia & Huntersville)]] and J. D. Ford in [[IN-05 (Fishers & Carmel)]], each now a predicted flip.
